purpose: P12/#1014: permitted module edges, exported port and Cargo feature configuration of the geometry engine crate, enforced through the normal local boundaries lane by a Rust-aware analyzer (scripts/nemo/lib/boundaries-rust.cjs). Module identity and layers come from rust.profile.json; this policy adds the rules that rust.coverage.json deliberately left unclaimed for the crate.
profileModulesNote: The four modules under sourceDir. rust.geometry.tests (geometry-wasm/tests) is an integration-test crate that reaches the port as `geometry_wasm::…`, an external path the intra-crate analyzer does not resolve; it stays covered by rust.coverage.json's discovery/size checks only.

adapters.meaning: lib.rs is the wasm-bindgen API: it declares the modules and re-exports the port; it may depend on the engine modules and on nothing else inside the crate

engine.meaning: engine.rs (renderer), shapes (eraser/fill/hit/shapes) and animation (interp/track/tween/tweenmatch/timeline/strokemodeler) may depend on each other but never on the API root or on tests

tests.meaning: integration tests may reach the port and the engine

permittedEdges.note: Observed at adoption from `use crate::…` and inline `crate::…` paths (analyzer output). Layer rules are the enforced contract; this list documents which edges exist so a new one is a visible diff.
edges: rust.geometry.api -> rust.geometry.engine (mod engine; pub use engine::{VelloEngine, create_engine})
rust.geometry.shapes -> rust.geometry.engine (crate::engine::{build_bezpath, build_bezpath_from_segments, ItemIn, SceneIn, SegIn})
rust.geometry.engine -> rust.geometry.shapes (inline crate::hit::hit_test_scene in engine.rs — see the cycle exception)
rust.geometry.shapes -> rust.geometry.api (eraser.rs use crate::{from_multipolygon, to_polygon, PolygonIn} — see the layer-violation exception)

exportedPort.source: geometry-wasm/src/lib.rs `pub use` re-exports; the wasm-bindgen free functions defined in lib.rs itself (boolean_op, boolean_op_multi, …) are the root's own API and are not re-exports

features.declaredNote: geometry-wasm/Cargo.toml has no [features] table; any cfg(feature = "…") in the crate is therefore a reference to an undeclared feature and fails. The only cfg predicates the crate uses are the two below; adding another predicate is a policy change, not a silent pass.

exceptions.reason: Known debt recorded at adoption, not repaired: eraser.rs imports the polygon conversion helpers (to_polygon, from_multipolygon, PolygonIn) that live in the API root lib.rs instead of an engine module. Moving those helpers into the engine layer is a separate bounded extraction; until then the edge is visible here and expires.
Same debt as the layer-violation above: eraser.rs -> lib.rs root helpers closes a cycle with lib.rs's own `mod eraser;` declaration. Removed together with that import.

Known debt recorded at adoption, not repaired: engine.rs calls crate::hit::hit_test_scene while hit.rs uses crate::engine::{build_bezpath, SceneIn}, a module cycle inside the engine layer. Splitting the shared scene-input types out of engine.rs is a separate bounded extraction; until then the cycle is visible here and expires.
